name: GitHub Enterprise (IBM)
tagline: IBM's internal GitHub Enterprise: repos, issues, PRs, and Actions for IBM employees.
description: IBM's GitHub Enterprise instance at github.ibm.com exposes the same GitHub API surface as github.com but scoped to IBM's internal network. It offers a remote MCP server, a fully-specified REST API, and a GraphQL API — all authenticated with IBM-issued personal access tokens.

methods.label: Personal access token
methods.note: Fine-grained PATs let you scope access per-repo and per-permission. Create one in your IBM GitHub Enterprise account settings.

auth.guide:
**Personal access token (required):** create one under [Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens](https://github.ibm.com/settings/tokens) on your IBM GitHub Enterprise instance. Prefer fine-grained tokens scoped to the repos and permissions your agent actually needs. Use it with REST and GraphQL:

```bash
# REST
curl https://github.ibm.com/api/v3/user -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_IBM_TOKEN"

# GraphQL
curl https://github.ibm.com/api/graphql \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $GITHUB_IBM_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"query": "{ viewer { login } }"}'
```

**MCP server:** point your client at `https://api.github.ibm.com/mcp` and pass a PAT bearer header: `Authorization: Bearer <your-pat>`.

**CLI:** `gh auth login --hostname github.ibm.com` stores credentials in your keychain; agents running in your shell inherit them.
